SELECT /*selectMasterWmGiOrderDeleteList*/ X.BUYER_NAME, X.PO_NO, X.GR_NO, X.STDCATLG_ID, X.PO_CREATE_DATE, X.GR_DATE, X.DELIVERY_DATE, X.PO_QTY, X.WMS_IVK_QTY, X.LIST_PRICE, X.LIST_AMT, X.STATUS_TEXT, X.LEGACY_PO_NO, X.IK_NO, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.RD_DATE, X.INV_DATE, X.DOC_TEXT, X.WMS_GR_QTY, X.DELIVERY_QTY, X.UNIT_PRICE, X.UNIT_AMT, X.DESCRIPTION, X.SPECIFICATION, X.AGENT, X.GI_DELIVERY_QTY, X.ADD_USER_NAME, X.ADD_USER_TEL, X.DELY_TO_LOCATION, X.PO_REMARK, X.BUYER, X.PO_SEQ, X.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, X.CONTRACT_NO, X.CONTRACT_SEQ, X.GR_SEQ, X.IK_SEQ, X.PO_HD_REMARK, X.DOC_TYPE, X.MASTER_ITEM, X.IMG_NO FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, A.PO_NO AS PO_NO, A.GR_NO AS GR_NO, A.STDCATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, A.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, A.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, A.DELIVERY_DATE AS DELIVERY_DATE, A.PO_QTY AS PO_QTY, A.WMS_IVK_QTY AS WMS_IVK_QTY, A.LIST_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE, A.LIST_AMT AS LIST_AMT, A.STATUS_TEXT AS STATUS_TEXT, A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, A.IK_NO AS IK_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, A.INV_DATE AS INV_DATE, A.DOC_TEXT AS DOC_TEXT, A.WMS_GR_QTY AS WMS_GR_QTY, A.DELIVERY_QTY AS DELIVERY_QTY, A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, A.UNIT_AMT AS UNIT_AMT, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.AGENT AS AGENT, A.GI_DELIVERY_QTY AS GI_DELIVERY_QTY, A.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, A.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, A.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, A.BUYER AS BUYER, A.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, A.GR_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, A.IK_SEQ AS IK_SEQ, A.PO_HD_REMARK AS PO_HD_REMARK, A.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, A.MASTER_ITEM AS MASTER_ITEM, A.IMG_NO AS IMG_NO FROM (
SELECT /*+USE_NL(PODT POHD)*/ ( SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, IVDT.INV_NO AS GR_NO,
PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID ,
POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, '' AS DELIVERY_DATE, NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0) AS WMS_IVK_QTY, NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0) AS LIST_PRICE, (NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) * NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0) AS LIST_AMT, DECODE(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0,'출고예정','분할출고예정') AS STATUS_TEXT,
PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, '' AS IK_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, '' AS INV_DATE, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI')||DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','(선입고)','X','(Kepmro)','(일반)') AS DOC_TEXT, NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) AS WMS_GR_QTY, NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.GR_QTY,0) AS DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, (NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_AMT, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, NVL(PODT.DI_QTY,0) AS GI_DELIVERY_QTY, PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK,
POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, '' AS IK_SEQ, POHD.PO_REMARK AS PO_HD_REMARK,
POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY > 0 AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' AND PODT.STATUS = 'D' AND PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND (PODT.BUYER LIKE 'KRXPR0%' OR PODT.BUYER = 'KRXPV00001')
AND PODT.BUYER IN
#{st_buyer_code}
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%')
AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_iv_no}||'%'
POHD.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_ik_no}||'%'
AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no}||'%'
UNION ALL
SELECT /*+USE_NL(PODT POHD)*/ (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, WIDT.S_INV_NO AS GR_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID , POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, WIDT.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE AS DELIVERY_DATE, NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) AS WMS_IVK_QTY, NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0) AS LIST_PRICE, NVL((NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) * NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0)),0) AS LIST_AMT, DECODE(WIDT.INV_QTY,WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,'배송확정',DECODE(WIDT.GR_QTY,WIDT.INV_QTY,'출고','분할출고')) AS STATUS_TEXT, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, WIDT.INV_DATE AS INV_DATE, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI')||DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','(선입고)','X','(Kepmro)','(일반)') AS DOC_TEXT, NVL(WIDT.GR_QTY,0) AS WMS_GR_QTY, NVL(WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,0) AS DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL((NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0)),0) AS UNIT_AMT, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, NVL(PODT.DI_QTY,0) AS GI_DELIVERY_QTY, PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, WIDT.S_INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, WIDT.INV_SEQ AS IK_SEQ, POHD.PO_REMARK AS PO_HD_REMARK, POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, WMSIVDT WIDT WHERE POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS = 'D' AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = WIDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = WIDT.S_INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = WIDT.S_INV_SEQ AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1', '3') AND POHD.AGENT = #{st_warehouse_agent} AND POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND (PODT.BUYER LIKE '#%' OR PODT.BUYER = 'KRXPV00001')
AND PODT.BUYER IN
#{st_buyer_code}
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no}||'%')
AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_iv_no}||'%'
POHD.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_ik_no}||'%'
AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no}||'%'
) A
ORDER BY A.RD_DATE,A.BUYER_NAME,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY A.BUYER_NAME,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY A.AGENT,A.BUYER_NAME,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ,A.BUYER_NAME
ORDER BY A.GR_NO,A.BUYER_NAME,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY A.IK_NO,A.BUYER_NAME,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO,A.BUYER_NAME,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY A.PO_REMARK,A.BUYER_NAME,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ
)X
WHERE X.STATUS_TEXT = #{st_status_text}
